summary: The post that falls through: {winner} names you for {the post}, and then {the problem} comes out.
realLife: One life: Named health secretary by President-elect Obama, he withdrew in February 2009 over unpaid taxes, saying he did not want to be a distraction. Another: He was dropped as head of Trump's transition after the 2016 bridge convictions, and his allies were removed. Another: Interviewed for FBI director in 2017, he withdrew within the week; his firm had Trump as a client.
